text.p: Mobile Telecommunication Technologies Corp said Friday it has sold a 20 percent equity stake in its Latin American operations to Newbridge Latin America LP in a deal valued at $35 million.
The company said it was part of its previously announced plan to establish its international subsidiaries as self-funding enterprises.

Newbridge Latin America is a private equity fund that was formed earlier this year to acquire significant stakes in Latin American companies. The fund plans to invest primarily in Brazil, Argentina and Mexico.

Mtel Latin America provides regional, national and international paging services in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Guatemala, Mexico, Paraguay, Peru, Uruguay, Venezuela and Puerto Rico.
